name: promokuznia
description: PromoKuźnia — sklep z materiałami marketingowymi (projekt portfolio, Cloudflare Pages + Functions + D1)

scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute promokuznia-db --local --file=seed/seed.sql
